row.evidence: Granola's pricing table marks "SCIM group provisioning" and "Single sign-on (SSO)" as Included only on Enterprise ($35 per user per month), and the help centre says "SSO and SCIM are available on the Enterprise plan only."
row.notes: Basic $0, Business $14, Enterprise $35 per user per month (billing period not stated on the page). SSO and SCIM need at least 50 active workspace members or a 50-seat Enterprise commitment, and SCIM needs an active SSO connection. Directory sync is set up through a browser portal; SCIM endpoint and token are copied into the IdP. Deprovisioning removes workspace membership. The Okta OIN Granola app is SAML SSO only. The public Granola API (Business+) covers notes, folders, webhooks, legal holds and an Enterprise Audit API; it has no user-management endpoints.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Notes API keys available; no user-management API.

auth.token_source: Settings > Workspace > General > Directory sync setup portal
auth.notes: Docs say a SCIM endpoint and token are copied into the IdP; the auth scheme is not documented.

limitations.text: Requires at least 50 active workspace members or a 50-seat Enterprise commitment.
Directory-synced members cannot be removed manually in Granola, and synced groups cannot be edited there.

user_api.notes: The Granola API (Business and Enterprise) exposes notes, transcripts, folders, webhooks, legal holds and audit events; no endpoints manage users, groups or roles.

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhook event types are note.access_granted, note.edited and note.generated only.

audit_log_api.notes: GET /v1/audit; includes workspace.member_added events; one-year retention.

okta.notes: OIN app lists SAML only; SCIM directory sync is configured separately through Granola's setup portal (Push Groups in Okta).

entra.notes: Entra named as an example IdP (c16); no Microsoft Learn tutorial found.

fallbacks.notes: With SSO and domain capture, accounts are created on first SSO sign-in; domain auto-join is also available.

Docs do not say whether SCIM deprovisioning frees the seat or ends sessions.
Pricing page does not say whether per-user prices are monthly or annual billing.
Which IdPs the directory-sync portal supports beyond Okta is not listed; Entra, Google, OneLogin and JumpCloud catalogue entries unconfirmed.
